title: ગંગા અને ઉમા, બે બહેનો | રામાયણ ભાગ 10
topic: Vishvamitra begins the Ganga's origin: Himavan and Mena's two daughters, Ganga the elder and Uma; the gods ask for Ganga and Himavan gives her for the good of the three worlds; Uma's austerity and her marriage to Rudra (Valmiki Ramayana 1.35.13–24; teaser 1.35.23–24)
edition: vulgate (southern recension), sa.wikisource; verse numbers cross-checked on valmikiramayan.net (Internet Archive copy)

sources.note: Rama: I wish to hear of the Ganga, the river of three paths; how did she pervade the three worlds and reach the lord of rivers? (Ep09 teaser, paid off here)
urged by Rama's words, the great sage Vishvamitra began to tell the Ganga's birth and growth
Himavan, lord of mountains (शैलेन्द्र), great mine of ores (धातूनामाकरो महान्), had two daughters unequalled in beauty on earth
their mother, Meru's daughter, slender-waisted and lovely, Mena by name, Himavan's dear wife
from her this Ganga was born, Himavan's elder daughter (ज्येष्ठा); Uma by name was his second daughter
then all the gods, wishing to accomplish the gods' work (देवकार्यचिकीर्षया), asked the mountain lord for his elder daughter, the Ganga, river of three paths
Himavan, by dharma (धर्मेण), gave his daughter, purifier of the worlds, the Ganga who flows where she wills, wishing the good of the three worlds (verse card)
receiving her for the sake of the three worlds, the gods, wishers of the worlds' good, took the Ganga and went, their purpose fulfilled
the other daughter of the mountain, a maiden whose wealth was austerity (तपोधना), took up a stern vow and performed tapas
the best of mountains gave his daughter Uma, endowed with fierce austerity and honoured by the worlds, to Rudra the peerless (रुद्रायाप्रतिरूपाय)
these are the mountain king's two daughters, honoured by the worlds: the Ganga, best of rivers, and Uma Devi
I have told you all of how the river of three paths first (प्रथमं) went to the sky (teaser verse)
so this lovely river of the gods, the mountain lord's daughter, sinless, flowing as water, rose to the world of the gods (teaser verse)
Rama and Lakshmana ask the sage to tell the elder daughter's story in full: by what cause does she flood three paths? (next episode, not narrated)

learnings.how: Applied. The stakes and the wonder are in the first sentence (the Ganga and Uma were sisters, paying off the Ep09 question about the Ganga), and the turn, the verse card where Himavan gives his daughter away for the three worlds, starts at about 23.5 s, inside the 18–25 s window. The 35 s shape is not used: the sarga needs both daughters, the gods' request, the gift, Uma's austerity and her marriage, so the 55 s two-beat shape is used, at about 53.82 s for flow.

Applied. The hook is 2.24 s, under the 3.0 s limit, with the stake in the first sentence, written natively short in each language (gu: ગંગા અને ઉમા સગી બહેનો હતાં.). The en hook is 2.66 s, inside the 2.5–2.8 s Kokoro-safe band. Frame 0 is the river of light pouring from the peak with Uma in meditation beside it, which the engine draws at least 70% by frame 0 (O5).

Applied on screen. Scene 10 carries the share prompt 'બેમાં મોટી બહેન કોણ?' (6 words or fewer) as its title card. It is answered in the text in scene 4 (1.35.16): the Ganga was the elder. It is not spoken, because no language has seconds to spare. The same line is suggested as the pinned comment so shares/reach can be compared.
